title: Fate's Reckoning
next_chapter_hook: When the shackles of destiny are severed, what is the price of freedom? Ling Yuan and Han Lie gazed at Chen Ji, their eyes gleaming with unprecedented light—and all of this is merely the beginning of a grander chess game.

text.content: In the instant Mo Xiansheng dissipated, the final page of the Tianji Record unfurled before Chen Ji like a phoenix rising from flames. On that yellowed surface, countless golden runes gathered like streams, ultimately condensing into a blazing line of text—'The Master of the Tianji Record shall be devoured by Heavenly Fate.' Chen Ji stared at those words, a cold smile curling at his lips. Hmph, the Eye of Heaven, you've finally shown your fangs. He traced the characters with his finger, feeling a searing sting. Does it hurt? Merely a preview. He closed the book, a cold light flashing in his gaze. The truth Mo Xiansheng had bought with his final breath—he would not waste it. In the distance, beyond the Tianqing Sect, two world-shaking auras were colliding furiously—Ling Yuan and Han Lie, the destined confrontation had finally begun.

On the wasteland beyond Tianqing Sect, the blood-red setting sun dyed the horizon crimson. Ling Yuan and Han Lie stood facing each other, the spiritual energy around them churned like an angry sea, crushing all rocks within several li into powder. Ling Yuan's blue robes were soaked in blood, yet he remained with hands clasped behind his back, his expression cold as an ancient frozen pond. Han Lie was drenched in blood, his eyes crimson red, his Xuanwu Sect's supreme cultivation art burning furiously within him. 'Ling Yuan!' Han Lie roared to the heavens, his voice shaking the nine heavens, 'Ten years! Today is your death day!' His fist carried world-destroying power as it smashed toward Ling Yuan. Where his fist wind passed, the air burst into black fissures, horrifying to behold. Ling Yuan sidestepped, his fingertip condensing a sharp sword qi, cold light flashing as it aimed for Han Lie's throat. The two figures clashed激烈 in the blood-red sunset, each collision stirring a world-shaking spiritual energy storm.

dialogue.content: 'Do you think I'm unaware?! All these years Tianqing Sect has been expanding in the shadows, devouring how many sects! And you, Ling Yuan—as the former Sect Master, what role have you played?! Today I shall seek justice for all living beings!'

text.content: Ling Yuan coldly laughed, his sword qi slicing through Han Lie's words: 'Justice? Han Lie, you're merely a chess piece manipulated by the Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance. All your so-called 'righteous actions'这些年你所谓的'替天行道'，不过是在替别人做嫁衣。' His voice was like nine-yin cold ice, 'You think your意志来决斗的吗？可笑！这场宿命的对决，从一开始就是被人精心设计的！' Han Lie's offensive faltered momentarily, then he swung his fists even more frantically: 'Don't try to shake me with such words! Today, either you die or I do!' The two's slaughter entered a white-hot stage, blood light and sword radiance intertwining into a gorgeous yet lethal scroll.

dialogue.content: Just then, a indifferent voice came from the void: 'Ling Yuan is correct. You two are indeed chess pieces—and ones deliberately manufactured.' Chen Ji slowly stepped out from the void, the Tianji Record floating beside him, golden runes circulating endlessly. He stood with hands clasped behind his back, his expression calm to the point of coldness. 'You two, have you not wondered after fighting for so long? Why does your strength always strangely tend toward balance with each encounter? Why can the hatred between you never be truly resolved?'

text.content: Ling Yuan and Han Lie simultaneously ceased combat, both turning to look at this suddenly appearing servant disciple. Han Lie frowned, a trace of contempt flickering in his eyes: 'Chen Ji? Atrash也敢在此大放厥词？' Ling Yuan, however, narrowed his eyes, his gaze falling on the Tianji Record beside Chen Ji, his pupils contracting sharply. Chen Ji ignored Han Lie's mockery, flicked his hand, and the Tianji Record's pages rustled open, finally stopping on a blurry image—an ancient ruin with two sleeping bodies bound by countless golden chains, the chains inscribed with complex formation runes. 'Recognize this place?' Chen Ji's voice carried a hint of playfulness, 'This is the secret laboratory of the Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance. And you two—' He paused, his gaze sweeping over Ling Yuan and Han Lie, 'are the 'Causality Experiment Subjects' they created.'

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's face changed drastically—this was a secret he had hidden for hundreds of years. His voice trembled slightly: 'How... how did you learn of this?' Chen Ji chuckled lightly, that smile carrying an indecipherable meaning: 'Ling Yuan Sect Master, or should I say—the previous generation's Tianji Record Inheritance Candidate. You thought you hated the Tianji Record because it chose Chen Xuan over you? Wrong. Your true hatred stems from the 'Causality Seed' the Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance implanted in you at birth. It made you and Han Lie develop irreconcilable hatred, allowing you to release causality energy through repeated life-and-death battles—all of which ultimately flows into the Eye of Heaven's true body.'

text.content: Han Lie's entire body jolted, a trace of confusion flickering in those crimson eyes: 'Nonsense! My hatred with Ling Yuan is personal grudge, what does it have to do with any Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance?!' Chen Ji shook his head, producing an ancient jade slip from his sleeve, gently breaking it. The jade slip shattered, projecting an image. In the footage, two infants were placed at the center of a massive formation, golden chains extending from all directions, binding them tightly together. An aged voice sounded in the image: 'Causality Experiment Subjects One and Two, establishing fate binding. As long as they hate each other and fight each other, they can continuously produce causality energy. Remember, they must never determine a victor—only endless fighting until death can maximize energy output.' The image dissolved, and the wasteland fell into deathly silence. Han Lie's eyes widened, his face full of disbelief.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji held the Tianji Record in his hands, golden runes circulating around him, making him appear like a deity descended: 'So you understand now? Your hundreds of years of slaughter was never from your own will. Your 'archenemy' identity is merely 'causality livestock' raised by the Eye of Heaven. Each time you fight, your life force is drained; each time you harbor killing intent, your soul is bound deeper.' He paused, a mocking arc curling at his lips, 'Han Lie, did you think your strength mysteriously increased after each defeat because you were a genius who grew stronger from setbacks? Pathetic—that's merely the 'Battle Amplification Program' implanted in you by the Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance.'

Han Lie's body trembled violently, his hands clutching his head as he let out an agonized roar: 'No... impossible! I clearly relied on my own efforts... I was clearly Xuanwu Sect's number one genius...' His voice was full of despair and unwillingness, 'Those life-and-death trials I experienced, those cultivation arts I comprehended... were they all fake?!' Ling Yuan's expression also wavered, he stared at Chen Ji, his voice hoarse: 'Then what about our hatred? We genuinely wanted to kill each other...'

text.content: Chen Ji slowly walked toward the two, each step seeming to tread on the strings of fate, producing heavy vibrations: 'Your hatred is certainly real—because it is a 'manufactured emotion' artificially created. The Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance's methods are extremely sophisticated; they implanted the causality seed deep in your souls, making you believe it was innate hatred.' He stopped before the two, the Tianji Record floating between the three of them. 'But now, the truth has been revealed.' He extended his hand, and a faintly glowing anchor-shaped mark appeared in his palm—the Heavenly Fate Anchor, the final treasure Mo Xiansheng left him before death. 'With this, I can sever your fate binding with the Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance.' Chen Ji's gaze was calm as still water. 'Severing causality will grant you true free will, no longer controlled by anyone. But the price is—' He turned sharply, 'Half of the strength you two have accumulated over hundreds of years will be reclaimed by the Eye of Heaven.'

choice.prompt: Ling Yuan and Han Lie fell into silence, their eyes flickering with complex emotions—anger, confusion, unwillingness, longing. Chen Ji gripped the Heavenly Fate Anchor, awaiting their decision. At this moment, the key to destiny rested in Chen Ji's hands.

choices.description: Chen Ji activated the Heavenly Fate Anchor, completely destroying the causality seeds within Ling Yuan and Han Lie, granting them true free will. The price was that their strength would be halved.
choices.visible_cost: Ling Yuan, Han Lie Combat Power Halved
choices.visible_reward: Completely break free from the Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance's control, gain free will
choices.risk_hint: The Eye of Heaven may detect anomalies and take action

text.content: Chen Ji hesitated no more. He tossed the Heavenly Fate Anchor high into the air, his hands forming complex印诀. The Awakening Mantra Mo Xiansheng taught him before his death was softly recited from Chen Ji's lips, each syllable seemingly prying at fate's foundations. The Heavenly Fate Anchor spun rapidly in the air, emanating a faint blue glow. Tendrils of light like silk wound toward Ling Yuan and Han Lie. 'This is...' Ling Yuan's pupils contracted sharply—he felt something struggling furiously within his body—the causality seed! It seemed to sense danger, attempting to break free. 'Don't let it escape.' Chen Ji said coldly, his palms suddenly pressing together. The Heavenly Fate Anchor erupted with world-shaking light, those blue threads instantly transforming into countless tiny blades, stabbing fiercely into the two men's bodies, uprooting the causality seeds completely!

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan let out an agonized roar to the heavens, every vein in his body standing out. The forcibly extracted causality seed manifested before him as a mass of black mist. Within the mist, countless twisted faces were vaguely visible, emitting piercing screams. 'This is the truth of your 'hatred' over these hundreds of years. It's not an emotion, but a parasite living in your souls!' Before his words even finished, he struck out with a palm, completely annihilating the black mist. At the same moment, the causality seed within Han Lie was also extracted. The two masses of black mist converged in the air, exploding with a deafening roar.

choices.description: Chen Ji chooses not to interfere with Ling Yuan and Han Lie's fate, letting them continue this destined confrontation. Causality energy will continue to be harvested by the Heavenly Secrets Guardians Alliance.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to completely resolve the archenemy plotline
choices.visible_reward: Observe the changing situation, preserve strength to face greater crises
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan and Han Lie might never gain freedom.

text.content: Chen Ji fell silent for a moment, then slowly retracted the Heavenly Fate Anchor. "Since the grudge between you two is so 'deeply ingrained,' why should I be the villain?" His voice carried a hint of sarcasm as he turned to leave. Ling Yuan frowned and shouted: "Stop! Since you know the truth, why won't you help us find liberation?" Chen Ji didn't look back, saying calmly: "Because your 'hatred' is too real—so real that even I can't tell if you genuinely want to kill each other, or if you're being manipulated by that karmic seed to kill each other." He paused, "Until you see your true hearts yourselves, I will not intervene." His words faded, and his figure vanished into the void. Ling Yuan and Han Lie stared at each other, the conversation exploding like thunder in their minds. The truth was so brutal—what should they do now?

choices.description: Chen Ji activated the forbidden technique of the Heavenly Fate Anchor, detonating the karmic seeds within Ling Yuan and Han Lie's bodies, completely annihilating both their souls to ensure nothing remains.
choices.visible_cost: Consumes a massive amount of Heavenly Fate Value, and may provoke a full-scale pursuit by the Heavenly Dao Guardian Alliance.
choices.risk_hint: Ling Yuan and Han Lie might not be true enemies—this action may cause irreparable losses.

text.content: A cold glint flashed in Chen Ji's eyes as the Heavenly Fate Anchor transformed in his palm, its ethereal blue glow turning into ink-black death energy. "Since you're both so enthusiastic about this fated slaughter—" His voice was ice-cold, devoid of any emotion, "Then let me draw the curtain on this play." Before the words even finished, the Heavenly Fate Anchor erupted with world-destroying power. Pitch-black chains surged from the void, binding Ling Yuan and Han Lie tightly! "Chen Ji! You've gone mad!" Ling Yuan roared, spiritual energy surging within him as he tried to break free. Han Lie was equally terrified, cursing: "Youtrash, how dare you attack us!" Chen Ji ignored them both, forming seals with both hands as he lowiy commanded: "Karmic Detonation—Annihilation!" A thunderous boom erupted as two blinding lights burst simultaneously from within Ling Yuan and Han Lie, followed by agonizing screams as their souls were torn apart. The karmic seeds were forcibly detonated, their life force rapidly draining away. "Stop!" A startled cry came from the distance—it was Su Qingyao!

Chen Ji slightly turned his gaze toward the approaching Su Qingyao, a faint smile curling at his lips: "Senior Fellow Su, what brings you here?" Su Qingyao landed beside Chen Ji, her gaze complex as she watched the chained Ling Yuan and Han Lie. She said heavily: "I sensed an anomalous karmic fluctuation and came to investigate. Chen Ji, what exactly are you doing?" Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, looking at Su Qingyao, his voice calm: "I'm ending a farce that has lasted several hundred years." He raised his hand, pointing at the two bound individuals, "Ling Yuan, Han Lie, can you feel it? That 'hatred' within you is fading." Ling Yuan and Han Lie exchanged glances, both seeing shock and confusion in each other's eyes. Indeed, something was disappearing—that blazing, overwhelming resentment that had burned in their hearts for centuries was now receding like an ebbing tide, replaced by an unprecedented emptiness.

dialogue.content: Han Lie gasped for breath, the crimson in his eyes gradually fading, replaced by clarity and exhaustion: "That hatred... it's truly gone..." His voice carried disbelief, "So all these centuries of obsession were actually the result of manipulation..." Ling Yuan's expression was equally complex as he stared at Chen Ji, a complicated light flickering in his eyes: "Chen Ji, you could have stood by and watched us fight to the death. Why expose the truth, and why help us find liberation?"

Chen Ji stood with hands clasped behind his back, the evening wind ruffling his robes, rustling loudly. He gazed at the setting sun sinking below the horizon, saying calmly: "Because you're still useful to me." His voice wascalm得近乎cold, "A manipulated chess piece only becomes someone else's weapon, but a person with free will can make true choices." He turned, his gaze sweeping over Ling Yuan and Han Lie, "This fated confrontation ends today. The karmic debt you owe me can be repaid slowly in the future." As his words fell, the Tianji Record automatically flew back into his hand, pages rustling as they turned, finally stopping on a blank page. Chen Ji raised his finger and wrote two names on the page—Ling Yuan, Han Lie. Below the names, he added a line of small text: "Karma severed, destiny rebooted."

text.content: At this moment, the heavens and earth suddenly changed color. A vast, ocean-like pressure descended from the nine heavens, suffocating everyone present. Chen Ji looked up to see a massive crack tear open in the void, and within the crack, a gigantic eye was revealed—that eye was cold, majestic, and supremely arrogant, precisely the projection of the Heavenly Dao's Eye! "Chen Ji..." An ancient and authoritative voice rang out from all directions, "You dare to destroy this one's experiment..." Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged as he guarded the Tianji Record before him, saying coldly: "So you've finally shown yourself. How does it feel, hiding behind the scenes, Heavenly Dao's Eye?" The giant eye slightly narrowed, revealing a hint of dangerous light: "You know too much. Since that's the case... perish alongside those twotrash!" Before the words finished, a sky-covering palm emerged from the void, carrying world-destroying force as it ruthlessly slammed toward Chen Ji!

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan and Han Lie's expressions both changed simultaneously—they could feel the terrifying magnitude of that pressure—power far beyond their comprehension! "Chen Ji!" Ling Yuan roared, the residual spiritual energy within him surging violently, transforming into a sword light that clashed against the giant palm. "I'm joining too!" Han Lie followed immediately, the Xuanwu Sect's supreme technique fully activated as it manifested into a massive Black Tortoise phantom, crashing thunderously into that palm. Both attacks struck the giant palm simultaneously, but like a dragonfly touching water, they only generated slight ripples. The Heavenly Dao's Eye projection let out a cold laugh: "Ants trying to shake a tree—utterly foolish!"

text.content: Chen Ji gazed at Ling Yuan and Han Lie standing side by side before him, shielding him from the lethal strike. A faint smile curved his lips. Just moments ago, these sworn enemies who had wanted to tear each other apart were now jointly blocking a fatal blow for him. What an ironic scene. He took a deep breath as the Tianji Record in his hand erupted with brilliant golden light, resonating with the Heavenly Fate Anchor. "Ling Yuan, Han Lie—" Chen Ji's voice pierced through the world-shaking pressure, clearly reaching both their ears, "Since you've chosen to stand with me, prepare to endure the Heavenly Dao's Wrath!" He raised the Tianji Record high, chanting quietly: "Tianji Record·Karmic Restoration!" In an instant, countless golden chains surged from the Tianji Record, connecting with the residual karmic forces within Ling Yuan and Han Lie. The powers of all three merged into a torrent at this moment, colliding mightily with the sky-covering palm! BOOM! A thunderous explosion echoed through the clouds as the shockwave turned everything within a hundred-li radius to nothingness. The Heavenly Dao's Eye projection let out a furious roar, the giant palm actually being forced back! "Impossible!" The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice was filled with shock and disbelief, "Three ants, actually able to resist this one's power?!"

Chen Ji knelt on one knee, spitting out a mouthful of blood. His Heavenly Fate Value was rapidly depleting, his face as pale as paper, yet a cold smile curled at his lips: "See that, Heavenly Dao's Eye? These are the 'ants' you spoke of—the karmic chess pieces you've manipulated for centuries, now fully awakened." He struggled to stand, tucking the Tianji Record into his chest, "This is only the beginning. When I collect all the fragments of the Tianji Record, it will be time to settle accounts with you!" The Heavenly Dao's Eye projection trembled violently, seemingly suppressing a towering fury. After a long while, that giant eye slowly closed, the crack in the void gradually healing. "Chen Ji..." The Heavenly Dao's Eye's voice echoed one final time in the void, carrying a chilling malevolence, "You have successfully drawn this one's attention. Next time, this one will personally act, erasing you and this entire world together!" With those words, the projection completely dissipated, and tranquility returned to the heavens and earth.

Ling Yuan and Han Lie exchanged glances, both seeing劫后余生的庆幸 in each other's eyes, along with an unprecedented sense of relief. Centuries of hatred finally reached its conclusion at this moment. "Chen Ji." Ling Yuan spoke first, his voice hoarse yet sincere, "Today's grace, I, Ling Yuan, will forever remember. From now on, whatever help you need, my entire Tianqing Sect will spare no effort." Han Lie, despite his fiery temperament, had no choice but to concede at this moment, saying heavily: "I, Han Lie, owe you my life. Though the Xuanwu Sect won't easily get involved in disputes, personally speaking—I'm at your disposal." Chen Ji wiped the blood from his mouth, standing up, saying calmly: "No need to make promises so quickly. You've just broken free from karmic shackles and need time to recover. As for what comes later..." He gazed toward the distance—that was the direction of the Tianqing Sect—"When you've thought it through, come find me." With that, he turned and left, his silhouette stretching long in the bloody sunset. Su Qingyao followed closely behind, pausing briefly to glance back at Ling Yuan and Han Lie, saying softly: "Congratulations to you both, you're finally free."

On the wilderness, Chen Ji and Su Qingyao walked side by side. The evening breeze brushed past, dispersing some of the bloody stench. Su Qingyao had been silent for a long time before finally speaking: "You knew all along that Ling Yuan and Han Lie were karmic experiment subjects?" Chen Ji hummed in affirmation, not denying it. Su Qingyao furrowed her brows: "Then why didn't you expose the truth earlier, letting them kill each other for so many years?" Chen Ji stopped walking, turning back to glance at that devastated battlefield, saying softly: "Because before they realized the truth themselves, any outsider's revelation would only make them think it was a scheme to sow discord." His gaze was deep and calm, "Only when they truly grew weary of this endless slaughter and proactively began to question would the truth have value." Su Qingyao gazed at Chen Ji's profile, a complex emotion surging in her heart. How many secrets was this seeminglytrash servant disciple hiding in his bones? She suddenly had a premonition—this man's chess game was far larger than she had ever imagined.

Night fell, the star river brilliant. Chen Ji stood alone atop the Tianqing Sect Back Mountain, slowly unfurling the Tianji Record. A new line of golden text appeared on the pages: "Karmic Rival Line·Complete. Unlock Achievement: Game Breaker. Receive Reward: Heavenly Fate Anchor·Fully Awakened." Chen Ji gazed at that line of text, a faint smile curving his lips. Ling Yuan and Han Lie—two chess pieces he had personally liberated from the shackles of fate, now possessed the qualifications to join his chess game. And the Heavenly Dao's Eye... He raised his head, staring at that profound night sky, a cold light flickering in his eyes. Since you've already noticed me, then wait. In the next volume, I'll let you know what truly means 'Heavenly Secrets Must Not Be Revealed.' The prophecy from the Tianji Record's final page echoed in his mind: "The Tianji Record Master shall be devoured by fate." Heh, devoured by fate? Then let's see—is it you who devours me, or I who devours you!
